passages.text: The proverbs of Solomon: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish son grief to his mother.
passages.sermon:
Solomon wrote many proverbs.
Solomon was a wise king of Israel.
A wise son makes his father happy.
A foolish son causes his mother sorrow.
passages.original: מִשְׁלֵ֗י שְׁלֹ֫מֹ֥ה פ בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם יְשַׂמַּח־ אָ֑ב וּבֵ֥ן כְּ֝סִ֗יל תּוּגַ֥ת אִמּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Ill-gotten treasures profit nothing, but righteousness brings deliverance from death.
passages.sermon:
Ill-gotten treasures do not help anyone.
These treasures bring no benefit.
Righteousness saves people from death.
Righteousness delivers from danger and destruction.
God values righteousness over dishonest gain.
passages.original: לֹא־ י֭וֹעִילוּ אוֹצְר֣וֹת רֶ֑שַׁע וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה תַּצִּ֥יל מִמָּֽוֶת׃

passages.text: The LORD does not let the righteous go hungry, but He denies the craving of the wicked.
passages.sermon:
The LORD cares for the righteous.
He does not let the righteous go hungry.
The LORD rejects the desires of the wicked.
He denies what the wicked crave.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ יַרְעִ֣יב יְ֭הוָה נֶ֣פֶשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וְהַוַּ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים יֶהְדֹּֽף׃

passages.text: Idle hands make one poor, but diligent hands bring wealth.
passages.sermon:
A person with idle hands becomes poor.
Idle hands do not work.
A person with diligent hands becomes wealthy.
Diligent hands work hard.
Hard work leads to wealth.
Laziness leads to poverty.
passages.original: רָ֗אשׁ עֹשֶׂ֥ה כַף־ רְמִיָּ֑ה וְיַ֖ד חָרוּצִ֣ים תַּעֲשִֽׁיר׃

passages.text: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during harvest is a disgraceful son.
passages.sermon: A wise son gathers during summer.\r\nA disgraceful son sleeps during harvest.
passages.original: אֹגֵ֣ר בַּ֭קַּיִץ בֵּ֣ן מַשְׂכִּ֑יל נִרְדָּ֥ם בַּ֝קָּצִ֗יר בֵּ֣ן מֵבִֽישׁ׃

passages.text: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
passages.sermon:
The righteous person receives blessings.
God places blessings on the head of the righteous.
The wicked person speaks with violence.
The mouth of the wicked hides violence.
passages.original: בְּ֭רָכוֹת לְרֹ֣אשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְכַסֶּ֥ה חָמָֽס׃

passages.text: The memory of the righteous is a blessing, but the name of the wicked will rot.
passages.sermon:
A righteous person lives in a way that pleases God.
People remember the righteous with blessing.
A wicked person does evil.
People remember the wicked with shame.
The name of the wicked will rot.
passages.original: זֵ֣כֶר צַ֭דִּיק לִבְרָכָ֑ה וְשֵׁ֖ם רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִרְקָֽב׃

passages.text: A wise heart will receive commandments, but foolish lips will come to ruin.
passages.sermon:
A wise person has a heart that listens.
A wise heart accepts commandments.
A foolish person speaks without wisdom.
Foolish lips lead to ruin.
passages.original: חֲכַם־ לֵ֭ב יִקַּ֣ח מִצְוֺ֑ת וֶאֱוִ֥יל שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יִלָּבֵֽט׃

passages.text: He who walks in integrity walks securely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
passages.sermon:
A person who lives with integrity walks securely.
This person does what is right.
This person is honest.
This person does not hide evil.
A person who twists his ways will be found out.
This person acts with deceit.
This person tries to hide wrongdoing.
Others will discover his actions.
passages.original: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בַּ֭תֹּם יֵ֣לֶךְ בֶּ֑טַח וּמְעַקֵּ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכָ֗יו יִוָּדֵֽעַ׃

passages.text: He who winks the eye causes grief, and foolish lips will come to ruin.
passages.sermon: A person who winks the eye causes grief.\r\nA person who speaks foolishly will come to ruin.
passages.original: קֹ֣רֵֽץ עַ֭יִן יִתֵּ֣ן עַצָּ֑בֶת וֶאֱוִ֥יל שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יִלָּבֵֽט׃

passages.text: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
passages.sermon:
The righteous person speaks words that give life.
His mouth is like a fountain that brings blessing.
The wicked person hides violence in his words.
His mouth covers up evil intentions.
passages.original: מְק֣וֹר חַ֭יִּים פִּ֣י צַדִּ֑יק וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְכַסֶּ֥ה חָמָֽס׃

passages.text: Hatred stirs up dissension, but love covers all transgressions.
passages.sermon: Hatred causes conflict.\r\nLove forgives every wrongdoing.
passages.original: שִׂ֭נְאָה תְּעוֹרֵ֣ר מְדָנִ֑ים וְעַ֥ל כָּל־ פְּ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תְּכַסֶּ֥ה אַהֲבָֽה׃

passages.text: Wisdom is found on the lips of the discerning, but a rod is for the back of him who lacks judgment.
passages.sermon:
A discerning person speaks with wisdom.
You will find wisdom on the lips of the discerning.
A person who lacks judgment receives punishment.
A rod is for the back of the one who lacks judgment.
passages.original: בְּשִׂפְתֵ֣י נָ֭בוֹן תִּמָּצֵ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝שֵׁ֗בֶט לְגֵ֣ו חֲסַר־ לֵֽב׃

passages.text: The wise store up knowledge, but the mouth of the fool invites destruction.
passages.sermon:
Wise people store up knowledge.
They keep knowledge safe.
A fool speaks carelessly.
The words of a fool bring destruction close.
passages.original: חֲכָמִ֥ים יִצְפְּנוּ־ דָ֑עַת וּפִֽי־ אֱ֝וִיל מְחִתָּ֥ה קְרֹבָֽה׃

passages.text: The wealth of the rich man is his fortified city, but poverty is the ruin of the poor.
passages.sermon:
A rich man has wealth.
His wealth protects him like a strong city.
A poor man has poverty.
His poverty destroys him.
passages.original: ה֣וֹן עָ֭שִׁיר קִרְיַ֣ת עֻזּ֑וֹ מְחִתַּ֖ת דַּלִּ֣ים רֵישָֽׁם׃

passages.text: The labor of the righteous leads to life, but the gain of the wicked brings punishment.
passages.sermon:
A righteous person works.
This work leads to life.
A wicked person gains profit.
This profit brings punishment.
passages.original: פְּעֻלַּ֣ת צַדִּ֣יק לְחַיִּ֑ים תְּבוּאַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע לְחַטָּֽאת׃

passages.text: Whoever heeds instruction is on the path to life, but he who ignores reproof goes astray.
passages.sermon: A person who listens to instruction walks on the path to life.\r\nA person who ignores correction goes astray.
passages.original: אֹ֣רַח לְ֭חַיִּים שׁוֹמֵ֣ר מוּסָ֑ר וְעוֹזֵ֖ב תּוֹכַ֣חַת מַתְעֶֽה׃

passages.text: The one who conceals hatred has lying lips, and whoever spreads slander is a fool.
passages.sermon: A person who hides hatred uses lying lips.\r\nA person who spreads slander is a fool.
passages.original: מְכַסֶּ֣ה שִׂ֭נְאָה שִׂפְתֵי־ שָׁ֑קֶר וּמוֹצִ֥א דִ֝בָּ֗ה ה֣וּא כְסִֽיל׃

passages.text: When words are many, sin is unavoidable, but he who restrains his lips is wise.
passages.sermon:
This proverb teaches about speech and wisdom.
Many words lead to sin.
Sin does not stop when people talk too much.
A wise person restrains his lips.
A wise person controls his speech.
passages.original: בְּרֹ֣ב דְּ֭בָרִים לֹ֣א יֶחְדַּל־ פָּ֑שַׁע וְחֹשֵׂ֖ךְ שְׂפָתָ֣יו מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃

passages.text: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver, but the heart of the wicked has little worth.
passages.sermon:
The righteous person speaks with wisdom.
His words are valuable like choice silver.
The wicked person has an evil heart.
His heart has little value.
passages.original: כֶּ֣סֶף נִ֭בְחָר לְשׁ֣וֹן צַדִּ֑יק לֵ֖ב רְשָׁעִ֣ים כִּמְעָֽט׃

passages.text: The lips of the righteous feed many, but fools die for lack of judgment.
passages.sermon:
The righteous person speaks with wisdom.
His words help many people.
Fools do not have good judgment.
Fools die because they lack understanding.
passages.original: שִׂפְתֵ֣י צַ֭דִּיק יִרְע֣וּ רַבִּ֑ים וֶֽ֝אֱוִילִ֗ים בַּחֲסַר־ לֵ֥ב יָמֽוּתוּ׃

passages.text: The blessing of the LORD enriches, and He adds no sorrow to it.
passages.sermon: The LORD gives blessings.\r\nHis blessing brings wealth.\r\nHe does not add sorrow to His blessing.
passages.original: בִּרְכַּ֣ת יְ֭הוָה הִ֣יא תַעֲשִׁ֑יר וְלֹֽא־ יוֹסִ֖ף עֶ֣צֶב עִמָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: The fool delights in shameful conduct, but a man of understanding has wisdom.
passages.sermon:
A fool enjoys doing shameful things.
A fool laughs at wrongdoing.
A man of understanding has wisdom.
A wise man acts with insight.
passages.original: כִּשְׂח֣וֹק לִ֭כְסִיל עֲשׂ֣וֹת זִמָּ֑ה וְ֝חָכְמָ֗ה לְאִ֣ישׁ תְּבוּנָֽה׃

passages.text: What the wicked man dreads will overtake him, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
passages.sermon:
A wicked man feels fear.
His fear will come upon him.
A righteous man has desires.
God will grant the desires of the righteous man.
passages.original: מְגוֹרַ֣ת רָ֭שָׁע הִ֣יא תְבוֹאֶ֑נּוּ וְתַאֲוַ֖ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִתֵּֽן׃

passages.text: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked are no more, but the righteous are secure forever.
passages.sermon:
The whirlwind comes.
The whirlwind passes.
The wicked disappear.
The wicked are gone.
The righteous remain.
The righteous stand firm forever.
The righteous are secure for all time.
passages.original: כַּעֲב֣וֹר ס֭וּפָה וְאֵ֣ין רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק יְס֣וֹד עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: Like vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so is the slacker to those who send him.
passages.sermon:
A slacker is someone who does not work hard.
A slacker causes trouble for those who send him.
Vinegar hurts the teeth.
Smoke irritates the eyes.
A slacker brings the same kind of trouble to his senders as vinegar brings to teeth and smoke brings to eyes.
passages.original: כַּחֹ֤מֶץ׀ לַשִּׁנַּ֗יִם וְכֶעָשָׁ֥ן לָעֵינָ֑יִם כֵּ֥ן הֶ֝עָצֵ֗ל לְשֹׁלְחָֽיו׃

passages.text: The fear of the LORD prolongs life, but the years of the wicked will be cut short.
passages.sermon:
The fear of the LORD gives people longer life.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD is holy and powerful.
The LORD rewards those who honor Him.
Wicked people do not honor the LORD.
The years of wicked people will be short.
God will cut short the lives of the wicked.
passages.original: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה תּוֹסִ֣יף יָמִ֑ים וּשְׁנ֖וֹת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּקְצֹֽרְנָה׃

passages.text: The hope of the righteous is joy, but the expectations of the wicked will perish.
passages.sermon:
The righteous hope for good things.
Their hope brings them joy.
The wicked expect good things too.
Their expectations will perish.
The righteous find joy in hope.
The wicked lose what they hope for.
passages.original: תּוֹחֶ֣לֶת צַדִּיקִ֣ים שִׂמְחָ֑ה וְתִקְוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃

passages.text: The way of the LORD is a refuge to the upright, but destruction awaits those who do evil.
passages.sermon:
The LORD shows the way.
This way is safe for upright people.
Upright people are honest and do what is right.
The way of the LORD protects them.
People who do evil face destruction.
Evil people act against God’s commands.
Destruction will come to those who do evil.
passages.original: מָע֣וֹז לַ֭תֹּם דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝מְחִתָּ֗ה לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

passages.text: The righteous will never be shaken, but the wicked will not inhabit the land.
passages.sermon:
The righteous person stands firm forever.
God keeps the righteous secure.
The wicked will not remain in the land.
God removes the wicked from their place.
passages.original: צַדִּ֣יק לְעוֹלָ֣ם בַּל־ יִמּ֑וֹט וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִשְׁכְּנוּ־ אָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom, but a perverse tongue will be cut out.
passages.sermon:
The righteous person speaks with wisdom.
The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom.
A perverse tongue speaks evil.
God will cut off the perverse tongue.
God removes those who speak evil.
passages.original: פִּֽי־ צַ֭דִּיק יָנ֣וּב חָכְמָ֑ה וּלְשׁ֥וֹן תַּ֝הְפֻּכ֗וֹת תִּכָּרֵֽת׃

passages.text: The lips of the righteous know what is fitting, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.
passages.sermon:
The righteous person speaks with lips that know what is right.
The righteous person understands what pleases God.
The wicked person speaks with a mouth that is twisted.
The wicked person says things that are wrong.
passages.original: שִׂפְתֵ֣י צַ֭דִּיק יֵדְע֣וּן רָצ֑וֹן וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת׃
